rows.title: Trust boundary
rows.body: The tenant_id arrives as request data; Auth + Tenant Resolver must establish the tenant context that governs every downstream read.

rows.title: Redaction mode
rows.body: For regulated tenants, ticket snippets are prohibited. Retrieval must skip the Ticket Summary Store before prompt assembly.

rows.title: Isolation requirement
rows.body: Enterprise customers require no cross-tenant access even in embeddings or the index. The brief states the requirement but not the mechanism.

rows.title: Broken learning loop
rows.body: Feedback reaches the Feedback DB, then stops. It is not used for evaluation gating or release decisions.

props.title: One request, step by step
props.deck: The logical sequence clarifies where tenant policy and redaction must constrain data access.

props.caption: Sequence for a question, conditional ticket-summary retrieval, answer generation, citations, and feedback.
props.code:
sequenceDiagram
  actor U as Customer / support agent
  participant API as copilot-api
  participant AUTH as Auth + Tenant Resolver
  participant RAG as RAG Orchestrator
  participant RET as Retriever
  participant IDX as Vector Index
  participant DOCS as Doc Store
  participant TIX as Ticket Summary Store
  participant LLM as LLM Gateway
  participant FB as Feedback API / DB

  U->>API: question + tenant_id
  API->>AUTH: authenticate and resolve tenant
  AUTH-->>API: tenant context + redaction mode
  API->>RAG: question + resolved tenant policy
  RAG->>RET: retrieve eligible context
  RET->>IDX: tenant-scoped similarity search
  IDX-->>RET: candidate IDs + scores
  RET->>DOCS: fetch tenant-eligible source content
  DOCS-->>RET: document chunks + source IDs
  alt Standard tenant
    RET->>TIX: optionally fetch tenant ticket summaries
    TIX-->>RET: allowed summaries
  else Regulated tenant · redaction mode
    Note over RET,TIX: Ticket snippets must not be requested or enter the prompt
  end
  RET-->>RAG: ranked context + citations
  RAG->>LLM: question + bounded context
  LLM-->>RAG: answer + cited source IDs
  RAG-->>API: response + citations
  API-->>U: rendered answer
  opt User gives feedback
    U->>FB: thumbs up/down + optional note
    Note over FB: Stored, but not used for evaluation gating
  end

props.content:
- Whether the request’s `tenant_id` is checked against the authenticated principal before retrieval.
- Whether the vector index is physically partitioned, namespaced, filtered, or protected by store-level authorization.
- Whether tenant scope is applied **before** nearest-neighbour search rather than filtering results afterwards.
- How redaction mode is stored, propagated, tested, and enforced when ticket summaries are optional.
- Whether cited source IDs are validated against both the retrieved context and resolved tenant before response delivery.
- Which model, prompt version, retrieved chunks, scores, policy decisions, latency spans, and token counts are persisted per answer.
- How feedback becomes a labelled evaluation set and a release gate.
